description: This script parses Khronos registry XML files related to OpenGL and EGL extensions, manages extension commands, and supports extension filtering and classification.

classes.name: GLCommandNames
classes.description: Manages OpenGL command names categorized by version.

classes.name: RegistryXML
classes.description: Parses and manipulates Khronos registry XML files for extensions and commands.

methods.name: script_relative
methods.description: Constructs a path relative to the script's directory.

methods.name: path_to
methods.description: Builds a path to a specific source folder and file.

methods.name: GLCommandNames.get_commands
methods.description: Retrieves command list for a specific version.

methods.name: GLCommandNames.get_all_commands
methods.description: Returns a combined list of all command names across versions.

methods.name: GLCommandNames.add_commands
methods.description: Adds new commands to a specific version's command list.

methods.name: RegistryXML.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the registry parser with XML files.

methods.name: RegistryXML._AppendANGLEExts
methods.description: Appends extension commands from an external extension XML file.

methods.name: RegistryXML.AddCommands
methods.description: Adds commands associated with a specific feature.

methods.name: RegistryXML._ClassifySupport
methods.description: Classifies extension support type based on attributes.

methods.name: RegistryXML.AddExtensionCommands
methods.description: Processes and adds extension commands based on supported extensions and APIs.
